skills.source: This week, the BYDO skill extraction pipeline was fully migrated to a Docker-based deployment setup.
The Streamlit-based upload interface was replaced with a lightweight FastAPI service.
Runs the full pipeline (extraction → normalization → ESCO reranking) as subprocess calls.
A Dockerfile was written to package the full pipeline into a single container image.
The image includes: Python 3.11 runtime and all pip dependencies.
The image includes: Python 3.11 runtime and all pip dependencies (FastAPI, sentence-transformers, PyTorch, etc.).
